description: This file contains a unit test class 'ScopeRepositoryTest' for testing the 'ScopeRepository' class in the OAuth module of the OrangeHRM system. It includes test methods to verify scope retrieval and scope finalization functionalities.

classes.name: ScopeRepositoryTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the 'ScopeRepository' class, testing scope entity retrieval and scope finalization functionalities.

methods.name: testGetScopeEntityByIdentifier
methods.description: Tests that retrieving a non-existent scope 'profile' returns null.

methods.name: testFinalizeScopes
methods.description: Tests that finalizing scopes returns an empty array when input scopes are empty.
